svg.title: Expansion headers
svg.desc: The mini PC chip with copper traces routed to four empty pin headers, J1 to J4: game streaming with Wolf and Moonlight on the iGPU; a call-center demo that calls real phones; more Home Assistant integrations for the inverter, the Samsung AC and the Tenda mesh; and backends for side projects.

g.text: Traces are routed. Nothing soldered yet.
PS2, NES-era tank games, Project Diablo 2
A demo that calls real phones,
